    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    AbstractBrick
    Abstract base class for all bricks.
    ArrayOperations
    Utility class for generic array manipulations.
    Board
    Interface defining the core logic and operations of the Tetris game board.
    Brick
    Interface representing a Tetris game piece (Tetromino).
    BrickGenerator
    Interface defining the strategy for generating new bricks (Tetrominoes).
    BrickRotator
    Manages the rotation logic for bricks.
    ClearRow
    An immutable data class that holds the result of a row-clearing operation.
    DownData
    It holds the information regarding cleared rows, the updated board state, the active brick's view data, and whether the game has ended.
    EventSource
    Enumeration defining the origin of a game event.
    EventType
    Enumeration defining the specific types of movement or actions available in the game.
    GameConfig
    Singleton Configuration Class.
    GameController
    The central controller for the Tetris game, bridging the gap between the UI and the game logic.
    GameMode
    Enumeration defining the available game modes.
    GameOverController
    Controller for the Game Over / Victory screen.
    GameOverPanel
    A custom JavaFX UI component that extends BorderPane.
    GameOverState
    Represents the state of the game after the game has ended.
    GamePoint
    A pure data structure for coordinates.
    GameState
    Interface for the State design pattern.
    GuiController
    The main view controller for the gameplay scene.
    HighScoreManager
    Manages the persistence of high scores and fastest times using Java Preferences.
    IBrick
    Represents the "I" shaped brick (Tetromino)
    InputEventListener
    Listener interface for handling game-related input events.
    InputHandler
    Handles all keyboard input and forwards actions to the GameController.
    JBrick
    Represents the "J" shaped brick (Tetromino)
    LBrick
    Represents the "L" shaped brick (Tetromino)
    LevelManager
    Manages the difficulty progression of the game.
    Main
    The entry point for the Tetris application.
    MainMenuController
    Controller for the Main Menu screen.
    MatrixOperations
    Utility class providing static methods for 2D array manipulations.
    MoveEvent
    Represents a movement-related input event in the Tetris game.
    MusicManager
    MusicManager handles background music for the game.
    NextShapeInfo
    A simple data carrier used by the BrickRotator to pass rotation information.
    NotificationPanel
    Displays temporary floating notifications (e.g., "Combo", "Level Up")
    OBrick
    Represents the "O" shaped brick (Tetromino)
    PausedState
    Represents the Paused state of the game.
    PlayingState
    Represents the active state of the game where gameplay mechanics are live.
    RandomBrickGenerator
    Implementation of BrickGenerator that provides a stream of random bricks.
    SBrick
    Represents the "S" shaped brick (Tetromino)
    Score
    Manages the scoring system using JavaFX properties for UI binding.
    SimpleBoard
    Represents the logical grid of the Tetris game.
    SoundManager
    SoundManager handles loading and playing UI sound effects.
    TBrick
    Represents the "T" shaped brick (Tetromino)
    ViewData
    An immutable Data Transfer Object (DTO) used to pass rendering information from the game logic (Board) to the User Interface.
    ZBrick
    Represents the "Z" shaped brick (Tetromino)
